title: "The Bond Films"

::: {#fa615310 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
bond = bond.sort_values("year")
```
:::


The Bond films run from 1995 to 2021.

::: {#cell-fig-bond .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (million US$)")
plt.show()
```
